name: Leaderboard List
description: A compact in-game index of AREDL, Global Demonlist Classic, and Pointercrate. / Indeks ringkas AREDL, Global Demonlist Classic, dan Pointercrate di dalam game.

panel-theme.name: Panel theme / Tema panel
panel-theme.description: Geometry Dash blue or midnight. Reopen the panel to apply. / Biru GD atau gelap. Buka ulang panel untuk menerapkan.

popup-size.name: Panel size / Ukuran panel
popup-size.description: Overall panel scale. Compact is the default and fits small screens. Reopen the panel to apply. / Skala panel keseluruhan. Ringkas adalah bawaan dan muat di layar kecil.

accent-color.name: Accent color / Warna aksen
accent-color.description: Tint for the tab marker and row rails. / Warna penanda tab dan garis baris.

compact-rows.name: Compact rows / Baris ringkas
compact-rows.description: Shorter rows so the panel stays small. Turn off for larger touch targets. / Baris lebih pendek agar panel tetap kecil. Matikan untuk target sentuh lebih besar.

row-stripes.name: Striped rows / Baris belang
row-stripes.description: Alternate row shading for readability. / Warna baris selang-seling agar mudah dibaca.

highlight-top3.name: Highlight top 3 / Soroti 3 besar
highlight-top3.description: Gold, silver and bronze rank colors for the first three places. / Warna emas, perak, dan perunggu untuk peringkat 1-3.

show-header-logo.name: Header emblem / Emblem judul
show-header-logo.description: Show the small demon emblem in the panel header. / Tampilkan emblem demon kecil di kepala panel.

show-footer.name: Footer credit / Kredit footer
show-footer.description: Show the author and version line in the panel footer. / Tampilkan penulis dan versi di kaki panel.

dim-background.name: Dim the game / Gelapkan game
dim-background.description: Darken only the game behind the panel. / Gelapkan hanya game di belakang panel.

dim-strength.name: Dim strength / Tingkat gelap
dim-strength.description: How dark the game behind the panel becomes (0-255). / Seberapa gelap game di belakang panel (0-255).

reduce-motion.name: Reduce motion / Kurangi animasi
reduce-motion.description: Disable the floating-button pulse. / Matikan animasi tombol pintasan.

rows-per-page.name: Levels per page / Level per halaman
rows-per-page.description: Rows shown per page; the panel height adapts. Reopen the panel to apply. / Jumlah baris per halaman; tinggi panel menyesuaikan.

default-tab.name: Default tab / Tab bawaan
default-tab.description: Tab selected when the panel opens (used when Remember last tab is off). / Tab saat panel dibuka (dipakai jika Ingat tab terakhir mati).

remember-tab.name: Remember last tab / Ingat tab terakhir
remember-tab.description: Reopen the panel on the last selected source tab. / Buka panel pada tab terakhir yang dipilih.

sort-descending.name: Reverse order / Urutan terbalik
sort-descending.description: Show the lowest ranks first instead of the top demons. / Tampilkan peringkat terendah lebih dulu.

show-rank.name: Rank numbers / Nomor peringkat
show-rank.description: Show the rank column on each row. / Tampilkan kolom peringkat di tiap baris.

show-thumbnails.name: Thumbnails / Thumbnail
show-thumbnails.description: Show a small preview tile per level. Off gives names more room. / Tampilkan kotak pratinjau kecil per level. Matikan agar nama lebih leluasa.

video-previews.name: Video covers / Sampul video
video-previews.description: Replace the placeholder with the YouTube cover when a list provides a valid video link (extra network use). / Ganti placeholder dengan sampul YouTube jika tersedia (memakai data tambahan).

show-source-marks.name: Source marks / Penanda sumber
show-source-marks.description: Show A, C, P marks for AREDL, Classic and Pointercrate. / Tampilkan penanda A, C, P untuk tiap sumber.

show-level-id.name: Level ID under name / ID di bawah nama
show-level-id.description: Show the in-game level ID below each level name. / Tampilkan ID level di bawah nama level.

confirm-open.name: Confirm before opening / Konfirmasi sebelum membuka
confirm-open.description: Ask before leaving the menu to open a level. / Tanya dulu sebelum membuka level.

page-wrap.name: Wrap pages / Halaman berputar
page-wrap.description: Next on the last page jumps back to the first, and vice versa. / Halaman terakhir kembali ke awal, dan sebaliknya.

cache-minutes.name: Cache duration (minutes) / Durasi cache (menit)
cache-minutes.description: Reuse loaded lists when reopening the panel within this time. 0 always refetches. REFRESH always fetches fresh data. / Pakai ulang data saat membuka panel dalam waktu ini. 0 selalu unduh ulang.

request-timeout.name: Request timeout (seconds) / Batas waktu (detik)
request-timeout.description: How long to wait for each list API before giving up. / Berapa lama menunggu tiap API sebelum menyerah.

show-floating-button.name: Show shortcut / Tampilkan pintasan
show-floating-button.description: Leaderboard button on the main menu. Drag to move, tap to open. If hidden, re-enter the main menu after enabling. / Tombol leaderboard di menu utama. Geser untuk memindah, ketuk untuk membuka.

floating-size.name: Shortcut size / Ukuran pintasan
floating-size.description: Button diameter on the main menu. / Diameter tombol di menu utama.

show-floating-label.name: Shortcut caption / Label pintasan
show-floating-label.description: Show a LIST caption below the button. / Tampilkan label DAFTAR di bawah tombol.

floating-opacity.name: Shortcut opacity / Opasitas pintasan
floating-opacity.description: Transparency of the main-menu button (percent). / Transparansi tombol menu utama (persen).

reset-floating-position.name: Shortcut position / Posisi pintasan
reset-floating-position.description: Return the button to its default spot on the main menu. / Kembalikan tombol ke posisi bawaan di menu utama.

about-info.description: Leaderboard List v2.3.0 by Aluxs. Data: AREDL, Global Demonlist Classic, Pointercrate. Level names, ranks and marks belong to their respective lists. Internet access is required. / Data milik AREDL, Global Demonlist Classic, dan Pointercrate. Perlu koneksi internet.
